import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 410;
    static final int M = 200020;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int[][] directions = {{-1,0},{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1}};
    static int[][] distMap = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] timeMap = new int[12][12];
    static char[][] grid = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] heat = new char[N][N];
    static int n, t;
    static MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow();

    static class MaxFlow {
        int[] head = new int[N], v = new int[M], nxt = new int[M], cap = new int[M], flow = new int[M], vv = new int[M];
        int e;
        int[] dist = new int[N], cur = new int[N];
        int s, t;

        void init() {
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
            e = 0;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            this.v[e] = v;
            this.nxt[e] = head[u];
            this.cap[e] = c;
            this.flow[e] = 0;
            this.head[u] = e++;
            this.vv[e] = u;
            this.nxt[e] = head[v];
            this.cap[e] = 0;
            this.flow[e] = 0;
            this.head[v] = e++;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                    int v = this.v[i];
                    if (dist[v] == -1 && cap[i] > flow[i]) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int a) {
            if (u == t || a == 0) return a;
            int ret = 0;
            for (int &i = cur[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                int v = this.v[i];
                if (dist[v] == dist[u] + 1 && (int)(Math.min(a, cap[i] - flow[i])) > 0) {
                    int f = dfs(v, Math.min(a, cap[i] - flow[i]));
                    if (f > 0) {
                        a -= f;
                        ret += f;
                        flow[i] += f;
                        flow[i ^ 1] -= f;
                        if (a == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }

        int maxFlow(int _s, int _t) {
            s = _s;
            t = _t;
            int ret = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                System.arraycopy(head, 0, cur, 0, head.length);
                ret += dfs(s, INF);
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static boolean valid(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void bfsObstacles(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int[] row : timeMap) Arrays.fill(row, 0x3f);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(sx * 10 + sy);
        timeMap[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int pos = q.poll();
            int x = pos / 10, y = pos % 10;
            for (int[] dir : directions) {
                int nx = x + dir[0], ny = y + dir[1];
                if (valid(nx, ny) && grid[nx][ny] >= '0' && grid[nx][ny] <= '9' && timeMap[nx][ny] > timeMap[x][y] + 1) {
                    timeMap[nx][ny] = timeMap[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(nx * 10 + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfsHeatSources(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int[] row : distMap) Arrays.fill(row, 0x3f);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(sx * 10 + sy);
        distMap[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int pos = q.poll();
            int x = pos / 10, y = pos % 10;
            for (int[] dir : directions) {
                int nx = x + dir[0], ny = dir[1];
                if (valid(nx, ny) && heat[nx][ny] >= '0' && heat[nx][ny] <= '9' && distMap[nx][ny] > distMap[x][y] + 1) {
                    if (heat[nx][ny] >= '0' && timeMap[nx][ny] >= distMap[x][y] + 1) {
                        distMap[nx][ny] = distMap[x][y] + 1;
                        if (timeMap[nx][ny] > distMap[nx][ny]) {
                            q.offer(nx * 10 + ny);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            heat[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfsObstacles(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        int S = 0;
        int T = n * n * 2 + 1;
        mf.init();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    mf.addEdge(S, i * n + j + 1, grid[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (heat[i][j] > '0' && heat[i][j] <= '9') {
                    mf.addEdge(n * n + i * n + j + 1, T, heat[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    bfsHeatSources(i, j);
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                            if (heat[x][y] > '0' && heat[x][y] <= '9' && distMap[x][y] <= t) {
                                mf.addEdge(i * n + j + 1, n * n + x * n + y + 1, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int result = mf.maxFlow(S, T);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
